pinDescription: You know your daily protein and carb targets, but how much raw chicken or dry rice do you actually need to buy? This walks through the yield factors that account for cooking loss and water absorption—so your grocery list matches your macro plan without waste or mid-week runs. Learn the reverse-engineering method that makes meal prep predictable.
